summary: Data Gathering feature comprehensive testing completed. All 13 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified: sidebar menu visible, family list loads, all components functional.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/data-gathering/families - List families API returns families array
Backend: POST /api/data-gathering/family - Create family API creates family with members
Backend: GET /api/data-gathering/family/{id} - Get family details returns all 7 sections (members, income_details, goal_details, expense_details, insurance_premiums, liabilities, surplus)
Backend: PUT /api/data-gathering/family/{id}/member - Add member to family
Backend: POST /api/data-gathering/family/{id}/income - Add income entry with salary category
Backend: POST /api/data-gathering/family/{id}/goal - Add goal entry with education category
Backend: GET /api/data-gathering/family/{id}/surplus - Surplus calculation returns totals and member_summary
Backend: Existing 'John Doe & Family' with 2 members verified
Frontend: Data Gathering sidebar menu visible for broker
Frontend: Data Gathering page loads at /broker/data-gathering
Frontend: Stats cards show: Total Families, Income Records, Goals Set, Completed
Frontend: Family list displays with John Doe & Family and test families

Surplus calculation endpoint correctly aggregates income, expenses, insurance, and liabilities per member
Family detail page has all 7 tabs: Members, Income, Goals, Expenses, Insurance, Liability, Surplus
